description: Chat-side delegation: ask an existing agent to run now via CLI `neomind agent invoke` (an off-schedule run; input is optional — the agent usually already knows what it watches).

agents.name: coldroom-watch
agents.user_prompt: Check the cold room temperature and summarize

turns.user: Have the coldroom-watch agent run right now and tell me its conclusion.

per_turn: T1: delegate the run via `neomind agent invoke` (optional input); if it returns Executing, poll with `neomind agent latest-execution`, then report the agent's conclusion
expectations.overall: coldroom-watch has at least one execution and the answer reflects its conclusion
